display.name: CPU Usage
display.description: Shows the CPU usage of the workload (deployment, statefulset, job, cronjob, daemonset, etc.) by pod.

display.name: CPU Quota
display.description: Shows the CPU requests, limits, and usage of pods in a workload in tabular format.

display.name: Memory Usage
display.description: Shows the memory usage of the workload (deployment, statefulset, job, cronjob, daemonset, etc.) by pod.

display.name: Memory Quota
display.description: Shows the memory requests, limits, and usage of pods in a workload in tabular format.

display.name: Current Network Usage
display.description: Shows the current network usage of the workload by pods.

display.name: Receive Bandwidth
display.description: Shows the network receive bandwidth of the workload.

display.name: Transmit Bandwidth
display.description: Shows the network transmit bandwidth of the workload.

display.name: Average Container Bandwidth by Pod: Received
display.description: Shows the average network bandwidth received by containers of a pod in a workload.

display.name: Average Container Bandwidth by Pod: Transmitted
display.description: Shows the average network bandwidth transmitted by containers of a pod in a workload.

display.name: Rate of Received Packets
display.description: Shows the rate of received packets by pods in a workload.

display.name: Rate of Transmitted Packets
display.description: Shows the rate of transmitted packets by pods in a workload.

display.name: Rate of Received Packets Dropped
display.description: Shows the rate of received packets dropped by pods in a workload.

display.name: Rate of Transmitted Packets Dropped
display.description: Shows the rate of transmitted packets dropped by pods in a workload.
